_comment: Standalone ThunksDB fragment for the vkd3d-proton D3D12 thunk. Merge the
DB entry into Data/ThunksDB.json (or the installed
share/fex-emu/ThunksDB.json); the ThunksDB block is what a per-application
config enables, exactly as Data/CI/VulkanThunks.json does for Vulkan.
The Overlay list is NOT how the PE path reaches this library. There the PE
shim names the .so explicitly through wine's unixlib loader and no overlay
is involved -- FEX loads the host half purely from the guest half's
LOAD_LIB constructor, which turns the name libvkd3d_d3d12 into
$FEX_THUNKHOSTLIBS/libvkd3d_d3d12-host.so. Putting the two files where FEX
looks is the whole of the registration for a game:
install -Dm755 build/libvkd3d_d3d12-host.so  $FEX_THUNKHOSTLIBS/libvkd3d_d3d12-host.so
install -Dm755 build/libvkd3d_d3d12-guest.so /usr/local/lib/fex-emu/libvkd3d_d3d12-guest.so
ln -sf <native>/libvkd3d-proton-d3d12.so     $FEX_THUNKHOSTLIBS/libvkd3d_d3d12.so.0
The second path is the PE shim's compiled-in default, overridable at run
time with VKD3D_THUNK_GUEST_SO. The third is the dlopen gate thunkgen's
generated loader insists on; see libvkd3d_d3d12_interface.cpp.
The overlay covers the OTHER direction: a guest that dlopens vkd3d-proton
by name -- an x86-64 Linux build of vkd3d-proton running under FEX, or a
Proton that ships it as ELF -- gets the thunk substituted instead. Both
native libraries are listed because libvkd3d-proton-d3d12.so is only a
loader shim: a guest that reached d3d12core directly would otherwise walk
straight past the thunk.
@PREFIX_LIB@ is expanded by FEX to the guest library directory.
